newsitem.title: JAPAN: Farm Ministry checking effects of rain on rice.
newsitem.headline: Farm Ministry checking effects of rain on rice.

text.p: The Ministry of Agriculture said on Thursday it was checking to see if there was any damage to rice crops from heavy rainfall in Kagoshima prefecture in Japan's southern Kyushu Island.
"We are now investigating for any possible effects on rice crops from the rain," a ministry official said.
"It is not clear at this stage if there is any damage to the rice crop," he said.

A landslide triggered by heavy rain killed at least 14 people and left about eight missing on Thursday when a torrent of mud and rocks swept over a village on Japan's southern Kyushu island, police reported.

Of Japan's total rice production of 10.34 million tonnes in the last crop year, output in Kagoshima prefecture accounted for 1.43 percent of the total, while output from all of Kyushu was estimated at around 12 percent, the official said.
